Who it is for

Reasoning is usually the fastest section to fix: this book shows the pattern behind every question type.

Buy it if

You can solve familiar questions but freeze when the pattern changes.

Avoid it if

You already clear reasoning comfortably in timed mocks.

How to use it

Learn one pattern, drill twenty questions of it, and move on - do not re-read the theory.

Pros and cons

Pros

  • A solved example behind every question pattern
  • Verbal and non-verbal reasoning in one volume

Cons

  • Some repetition across chapters
  • Non-verbal figures print small in a few editions
